title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
Reed Business Support are seeking an energetic, creative and commercially minded Brand Marketing Manager to take ownership of an established business based in Teesside across their UK and US markets. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building brands, creating engaging content and delivering measurable marketing results.

The successful candidate will drive brand awareness, lead marketing initiatives, manage external marketing partners and identify opportunities for growth. You'll immerse yourself in the business, understand its operations and play a key role in shaping the future direction of their brand.

Working Hours & Benefits

Hours:
- Monday to Thursday: 7:45am - 4:30pm
- Friday: 8:00am - 12:00pm

Hybrid Working:
- Office-based during onboarding.
- Work-from-home Friday mornings available following successful training.

Benefits:
- Paying a competitive salary
- 23 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Free onsite parking.
- Fully equipped facilities.
- Opportunity to make a significant impact within a growing business.

Key Duties:
- Develop and deliver marketing strategies aligned to business goals.
- Strengthen market positioning and drive brand growth.
- Create campaigns that increase awareness, engagement and lead generation.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities.
- Ensure consistent branding across all channels.
- Lead and execute content strategies across digital, social and traditional platforms.
- Produce engaging content showcasing the business, its people, products and services.
- Capture authentic content within operational environments.
- Manage photography, videography, social media content and drone footage assets.
- Coordinate and optimise multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Manage relationships with external marketing providers.
- Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and against objectives.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop effective marketing initiatives.
- Present marketing plans and performance insights to senior leadership.

Candidate Requirements:
- Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies.
- Strong brand management and content marketing experience.
- Experience managing multiple marketing channels.
- Exposure to USA markets is advantageous.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.

Personal Attributes
- Energetic, proactive and self-motivated.
- Creative thinker with strong commercial awareness.
- Confident working independently and taking ownership.
- Strong relationship-building skills.
- Passionate about brand growth and business success.

title: Community Engagement & Events Fundraiser
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and passionate Community Engagement & Events Fundraiser to join our team! In this vital role, you will lead efforts to build meaningful relationships within the community, organise impactful events, and drive fundraising initiatives that support our mission. You will contribute to the management of the HospiceCare community fundraising and events programme, driving income growth, increasing the Hospice profile across local communities, developing partnerships, and leading a strong volunteer network to support sustainable fundraising.

Key Responsibilities

Developing relationships with individual and community supporters and fundraising volunteers; generation and maximisation of income across community fundraising; contribute to fundraising strategy development.

Communication and relationships
- Build and maintain excellent communication and relationships with key partners and stakeholders.
- Work in collaboration with the clinical team and volunteer fundraisers
- Build and maintain excellent communication and relationships with all HospiceCare staff and volunteers.

Fundraising Events
- Day to day management of the events programme
- Lead on the oversight and development of sponsored led events and contribute to the planning, delivery and evaluation of Hospice Led events
- Develop sponsored challenges and campaigns
- Ensure compliance, risk assessments and event budgets are managed effectively
- Build on the existing annual programme of fundraising events, thinking creatively to develop innovative ideas and new opportunities.
- Work closely with volunteers to plan and deliver events efficiently and profitably.
- Review all event and expenditure against budgets.
- Maintain detailed records of events including relevant volunteer feedback to promote continuous improvement.

Community Fundraising
- Develop ways of recognising and encouraging those who already fundraise on our behalf.
- Actively recruit and motivate local supporters and fundraising groups across our community offering appropriate advice, resources and recognition.
- Identify and develop fundraising opportunities throughout North Northumberland with formal local groups and associations, e.g. clubs, schools, workplaces, Parish Councils.

Marketing / PR

Work with and support the Digital Lead to:
- Seek out and exploit all appropriate means of marketing events and raising awareness of HospiceCare services.
- Promote and participate in a programme of HospiceCare Talks / Presentations to local groups.
- Support the regular production of a newsletter for supporters and interested parties.

Volunteer Management
- Contribute to the recruitment and retention of fundraising volunteers.
- Induct, train, support and recognize volunteers
- Build volunteer-led fundraising groups across North Northumberland

Management and Reporting
- Monitor budgets, KPIs and event performance.
- Produce reports and recommendations for senior leadership.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and supporter data.

Key Performance Indicators
- Annual fundraising income targets achieved or exceeded
- Growth in community fundraising participation.
- Increased volunteer recruitment and retention.
- Growth in sponsored event participation.
- Increased community partnerships and supporter engagement.
- Positive return on investment across fundraising events.

General
- There will be a requirement to work some evenings and weekends in order to attend/support events.
- Have a flexibility to work on own initiative as well as with other team members and volunteers. There will be a requirement to work with volunteers, including delegating and supervising tasks and managing their time.
- Take responsibility for all administration associated with key tasks, monitoring any work delegated to admin staff or volunteers.
- Maintain and assist in development of relevant areas of HospiceCare contact database.
- Be aware of and comply with relevant legal requirements relating to fundraising, volunteers, charity accounting, health and safety.
- Produce reports as required.
- Identify new and innovative ways to create new income streams for the Hospice.
- Regularly monitor, review and improve all activities.
- Maintain confidentiality of all personal information.
- To undertake any other duties as appropriate within the competence level and general level of responsibility of the post as required by the Head of Income Generation.

Person Spec - Essential

Skills & Knowledge:
- Excellent communication skills both written and oral.
- High degree of administration skills, e.g. maintaining databases as well as keeping efficient filing systems.
- Excellent knowledge of data protection regulations and experience of processing data.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to work to deadlines.
- Ability to work on own initiative.
- Able to provide excellent stewardship to supporters
- A strong communicator, demonstrating the ability to relate to groups and individuals and build lasting positive relationships
- Ability to communicate with internal and external stakeholders
- Experience of community engagement activities and strategies

Experience:
- Experience of working with people at all levels.
- Demonstrable cash handling experience.

Disposition:
- Flexible - able to work outside of office hours.
- Resilient.
- Highly motivated self-starter
- Ability to work on own initiative in a busy environment.
- A keen eye for detail and the ability to work to deadlines ensuring a project is completed to deadline.
- A team player with responsibility for own areas of work
- Flexible, able to support and encourage staff and volunteers
- Self-reliant and persistent in approach, flexible and able to handle pressure
- Good sense of humour and ability to work calmly and cheerfully as part of a team and under pressure
- Ability to adapt to change
- Ability to demonstrate HCNN values
- A commitment to the aims and objectives of HCNN

Technical & Qualifications:
- Competent in using Word, Microsoft Excel, Mail Merge, CRM systems
- Able to use the internet to source and research new funding opportunities
- An understanding of Social media and its value in fundraising

Circumstances:
- Ability to travel throughout the region.
- Independently mobile

This role description is intended as a basic guide to the responsibilities of the post and is not exhaustive and may be subject to review in consultation with the post holder.

Interviews to be held - 11th - 12th November 2026

title: Senior Client Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing B2 B marketing agency based in Northumberland working with regional, national and international clients across sectors including engineering, manufacturing, technology, renewables and life sciences. The business delivers integrated marketing services including PR, digital marketing, content, design, SEO and website development, helping innovative organisations grow their visibility and market presence.

The Senior Client Marketing Manager will look after a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships and helping to grow existing business. The role involves developing marketing plans, overseeing campaigns, and working closely with clients to ensure activity delivers against their objectives and supports long-term growth.

Job Responsibilities:
- Managing and developing a portfolio of client accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders.
- Acting as the main point of contact for clients, providing strategic marketing advice and ensuring a high level of service.
- Creating marketing strategies and campaign plans that support client objectives and deliver results.
- Working with internal teams across content, PR, digital, design and web to deliver integrated marketing campaigns.
- Identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts and supporting business development activities.
- Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
- Driving client retention through proactive account management and consistent value delivery.
- Keeping campaigns and marketing initiatives on track, ensuring agreed actions are completed and objectives are achieved.

Job Requirements:
- Experience managing and growing B2 B client accounts, ideally within an agency environment or across multiple businesses and brands as part of a wider group.
- A strong marketing background with experience developing marketing strategies and integrated campaigns that deliver results.
- The ability to understand client objectives and turn them into effective marketing plans and campaigns.
- Experience managing multiple projects and working with a range of internal teams to deliver successful outcomes.
- A track record of identifying opportunities to grow client accounts and increase revenue.
- Excellent relationship-building, communication and presentation skills.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance client needs with business objectives.
- A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A genuine interest in working with innovative businesses across technical and specialist sectors.

title: Digital PR Consultant
company: BMC Recruitment Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description: Digital PR Consultant
Location: North East England (Hybrid) Salary: Up to £40,000 Agency Environment
A well-established and growing integrated marketing agency in the North East is looking to appoint a Digital PR Consultant to join its expanding team. Due to continued client growth and increasing demand for Digital PR services, this is an opportunity to take ownership of campaigns, build strong client relationships, and deliver impactful results across a diverse client portfolio.
This position would suit an ambitious Digital PR professional who enjoys hands-on campaign delivery, media relations, content ideation, and securing high-quality coverage.
The Role
As a Digital PR Consultant, you'll be responsible for planning and delivering Digital PR campaigns that generate meaningful media coverage, backlinks, brand awareness, and commercial results for clients.
Working closely with clients and internal specialists, you'll develop creative campaign ideas, build relationships with journalists, and drive coverage across national, regional, trade, and online publications.
Key Responsibilities
- Deliver Digital PR campaigns from concept through to execution.
- Develop creative story angles and outreach strategies.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, influencers, and key media contacts.
- Secure high-quality media coverage and backlinks across relevant publications.
- Create press releases, media pitches, and supporting campaign content.
- Manage day-to-day client communication and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide insight-driven recommendations.
- Collaborate with SEO, Content, Social, and Marketing teams to maximise campaign impact.
- Identify reactive PR opportunities and newsjacking opportunities.
- Support the development of new campaign ideas and ongoing client growth.

About You
We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience within Digital PR, PR, Content Marketing, or a related agency environment.
- A proven track record of securing media coverage and building journalist relationships.
- Strong written communication and storytelling abilities.
- Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Commercial awareness and confidence working directly with clients.
- A proactive, creative approach to campaign generation.
- Knowledge of SEO and link-building principles would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £40,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working model.
- Genuine opportunities for progression and development.
- A collaborative and supportive agency culture.
- The chance to work with a wide range of well-known brands and exciting clients.
- A business that continues to invest heavily in its Digital PR offering and future growth plans.

title: PPC & SEO Account Executive
description:
PPC & SEO Account Executive

Hybrid Working Minimum 2 Days Office-Based Mon & Wed
£32,000 - £37,000 per annum
Full-Time, 37 Hours per Week

Are you passionate about paid and organic search? Do you enjoy analysing data, testing new ideas and driving measurable results?

We are looking for a PPC & SEO Account Executive to join our clients growing marketing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded digital marketer who thrives on improving performance, uncovering opportunities, and staying ahead in the ever evolving world of search.

Working closely with the Marketing Lead, you'll take ownership of day-to-day PPC and SEO activity, helping to drive visibility, traffic and conversions across Google, Bing and emerging AI-powered search platforms.

What You'll Be DoingPPC Management

Build, launch and optimise campaigns across multiple advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, OpenAI Ads and Amazon Advertising

Conduct keyword research, create compelling ad copy and manage bids, budgets and campaign performance

Monitor account performance daily, identifying opportunities for growth and optimisation

Run A/B testing across audiences, ad copy and landing pages to improve conversion rates

Maintain account health, including quality scores, tracking, feeds, automations and ad compliance

Analyse campaign data and provide recommendations to maximise ROI

Manage advertising budgets effectively to deliver strong value for money

SEO & Organic Search

Conduct keyword research, mapping and content gap analysis

Optimise website content and landing pages to improve rankings, traffic and conversions

Create and brief engaging content including blogs, FAQs and search-focused resources

Support technical and on-site SEO improvements

Contribute to link-building strategies aligned with industry best practice

Monitor search trends and stay ahead of developments in AI-powered search and evolving customer behaviour

Reporting & Analysis

Produce insightful reports using Google Analytics 4 and platform data

Translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations

Support stakeholder reporting and performance reviews

Act as the day-to-day technical contact for PPC and SEO activity

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:

Minimum 12 months hands-on PPC and/or SEO experience

Experience managing campaigns within Google Ads

Understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, content optimisation and link-building

Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data

Experience using Google Analytics 4

Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities

A commercial mindset and ability to make data-driven decisions

A genuine interest in the future of search and AI technologies

Facebook Ads

OpenAI Ads

Amazon Advertising

Looker Studio reporting

Experience within a product-led business environment

What You'll Get In Return

Competitive salary of £32,000 - £37,000

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Excellent work-life balance:
- Monday-Thursday: 9:00am - 5:00pm

Smart salary sacrifice pension scheme with 5% employer contribution

Cycle to Work scheme

Apply Today

title: Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator
description:
Permanent 20-30 hours per week Monday to Friday

£30,000 FTE, pro rata

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Sales, Finance & Marketing Administrator to join our team at Executive Compass.

This is a permanent, office-based role at Hoults Yard in Newcastle, with flexible part-time hours across five days.

You can work between 20 and 30 hours per week, for example:
- 10am-2pm, Monday to Friday
- 9am-3pm, Monday to Friday

or another agreed pattern within those parameters.

This role could suit someone looking for a professional part-time position with predictable weekday hours.

About the role

Executive Compass is an independent bid writing consultancy supporting organisations across the UK to win public and private-sector contracts.

You will join our sales, finance and marketing team and help keep our day-to-day commercial administration accurate, organised and running smoothly.

Your main responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining client, enquiry and opportunity records in Salesforce
- Setting up new clients and projects
- Carrying out company credit checks using Creditsafe
- Issuing terms and conditions through Signable
- Raising and issuing invoices through Xero
- Maintaining accurate spreadsheets and business records
- Monitoring outstanding invoices and supporting credit control
- Liaising professionally with clients by telephone and email
- Providing wider sales, marketing and administrative support.

As the role develops, there may also be opportunities to support outbound marketing, website administration and other commercial activities.

About you

You do not need previous experience of bid writing or tenders.

However, this is not a trainee administration role. We are looking for someone who already has experience working in an office, administration, finance support, sales support or similar business environment.

You should be:
- Highly organised
- Accurate and detail-focused
- Confident using IT and learning new systems
- Comfortable working with spreadsheets and business data
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- Able to manage your own workload
- Proactive and dependable
- Comfortable working in a busy professional office.

Experience of Salesforce, Xero or similar CRM/accounting systems would be helpful but is not essential.

Salary and hours

£30,000 full-time equivalent, pro rata according to hours worked.

The role is available for 20-30 hours per week across Monday to Friday.

Typical working patterns could include:
- 20 hours: approximately 10am-2pm
- 30 hours: approximately 9am-3pm

There is some flexibility around exact start and finish times.

Benefits

You will join a friendly and supportive Newcastle-based team and receive:
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, pro rata
- Annual leave increasing to 30 days following the qualifying period
- An additional birthday holiday following probation
- Annual salary reviews
- Opportunities for paid overtime
- Fully funded training and development
- Opportunities to broaden the role as the business develops
- Regular staff social events
- A modern office environment at Hoults Yard.

Location

This role is office based at Hoults Yard, Newcastle upon Tyne.

Applicants must be able to travel reliably to Hoults Yard Monday to Friday.
